chapter.verse: Tate aw, na pa uh’ hong hilhnate ngai un la, thu na teltheih nadingun lim takin ngaihsun un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh kong hilh thute thuhoih ahi hi; kong hilhte khempeuh lim takin, ciamteh un.
Kei zong ka nu leh ka pa’ tapa neihsun, naupangno khat ka hih lai-in,
ka pa in thu hong hilh a, “Ka thugente ciamteh in la mangngilh ngei kei in. Kong gen bangin gamta in, tua hi leh na nungta ding hi.
Pilna leh thu ngaihsut theihna na neih nading hahkat in la, kong gen thute mangngilh kei in la, hoih takin, ngaihsun in.
Pilna nusia kei in, tua hi leh siatna panin nang hong hu ding hi, pilna deih in, tua hi leh lungmuang takin na om nadingin hong kem ding hi.
Pilna na ngah nading a thupi masapen hi a, na neih khempeuh na bei lawh zongin na zon’ ding ahi hi.
Pilna deih in, mi lianin nang hong bawl ding hi; limtak pom in, pahtawina hong ngah sak ding hi.
Pilna in pahtawina leh minthan’na, nang tungah hong tung sak ding hi,” hong ci hi.
Ka ta aw, ka thugente lim takin zui in, tua hi leh na khan a sau ding hi.
Na pil nading lampi kong hilh zo a, na gamtat nading zia kong gen zo hi.
Hoih takin gamta lecin bangmah in hong nawngkaisak lo ding a, na tai hangin zong na puk kha kei ding hi.
Hong kihilhnate lencip in la khahsuah kha kei in; na nuntak nading ahih manin lim takin zui in.
Migilote tawh kikhawl kei in la, amau’ gamtatnate zui kei in.
Amau’ gamtat bangin gamta peuhmah ke’n! Gitlohna peel in! Pai san in la, na maban sem in.
Migilote in asia khatpeuh a sep mateng lum thei lo uh a, mi khatpeuh a suk zawh mateng ihmu lo uh hi.
Gitlohna, annek bangin nuamsa uh a, ngongtatna, tuidawn bangin ngaihsun uh hi.
Ahi zongin thuman mite’ zuih lampi ahih leh, sun dong a taang pha semsem zing khuavak tung tawh kibang hi.
Migilote’ lampi ahih leh zan khuamial bangin mial a, amaute a tuksak, a suihkhak nate nangawn mu thei lo uh hi.
Ka ta aw, ka thugente don in la ka kammalte ngai in.
Na kiang panin paikhia sak kei in la, na lungsim ah ciamteh in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh tua thu a zuite in, nuntakna leh cidamna-in nei uh hi.
Na lungsim ngaihsutnate in nuntakna nak hi a, na neihsa a manphapen bangin na kep ding ahi hi.
A man lo thu gen ngei kei in la, zuauthu leh a kiza khial thei ding kammalte zang het kei in.
Kisuan’na nei loin om liuliau in la, maizumin kuncip kei in.
Na khatpeuh na sepna thu theitel in, tua hi leh na sep peuhpeuh mavang ding hi.
Siatna peelin a maanin gamta in la, thuman lampi panin themcik zong pial kha kei in.
